diagram_math_checks.subject: Common threshold geometry
diagram_math_checks.check: Relative to O=(0,2.8), vertices are (0,1), (-sqrt(3)/2,-1/2), (sqrt(3)/2,-1/2), using 0.8660254 as plotting approximation. Each vertex has radius 1 and each side length sqrt(3). The heavy horizontal side has midpoint distance 1/2. The triangle is explicitly closed by the final segment to (0,3.8).
diagram_math_checks.justification: Example fixes unit radius and equilateral side threshold; Verification 1.1 identifies the same sqrt(3) threshold. Native output visibly has all three triangle edges.

diagram_math_checks.subject: Angle sampling interval
diagram_math_checks.check: The interval from x=3.5 to 6.5 parametrizes Theta in [0,pi]. The threshold x=5.5 is 2/3 of the full interval, so the cyan final length 1 of total length 3 represents (2pi/3,pi] and probability 1/3. The lower endpoint is an open ring.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification 1.1: chord length 2 sin(Theta/2)>sqrt(3) iff Theta>2pi/3 on [0,pi].

diagram_math_checks.subject: Uniform-radius sampling
diagram_math_checks.check: The interval x=-1.5 to 1.5 parametrizes midpoint distance r in [0,1]. Its cyan first half ends in an open ring at r=1/2, giving normalized length 1/2. The center endpoint r=0 belongs to the favorable set.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification 2.1 states the midpoint criterion. Independently, half-chord length is sqrt(1-r^2), so 2 sqrt(1-r^2)>sqrt(3) iff r<1/2.

diagram_math_checks.subject: Uniform-disk sampling
diagram_math_checks.check: The outer radius is 1 and the cyan favorable disk radius is 0.5, concentric at (5,-0.55). Its normalized area is pi(1/2)^2/pi=1/4. Dashed inner boundary denotes exclusion. Single interval thresholds and a disk circle have zero normalized length/area, consistent with strict inequalities.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Example model 3 and Verification 2.1 require uniform planar area, rather than uniform radial distance. The figure explicitly distinguishes these measures.

diagram_math_checks.subject: Proof independence
diagram_math_checks.check: All original Example, Facts, and Verification text remains byte-identical. The figure is after Verification in Remarks and supplies no premise or step of the rigorous proof.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exact prefix comparison to frozen before source succeeded.

native_visual_check.inspection: Both final native PNG tiles independently viewed standalone at original resolution. Four panels, all triangle edges, labels, cyan favorable regions and open interval threshold rings are visible without overlap. Second tile completes lower panels because the capture is vertically tiled, not source clipping. SVG endpoint paths use fill=#020202 and stroke=#0ff, and standalone dark-background images visibly confirm hollow rings. Earlier preview used fill=black, which compiled to currentColor and appeared filled; corrected concrete observed issue before final report.
